rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a process, method, or person that uses time and resources well.

example.english: This method is efficient, saving time and manpower.
example.traditional: 呢個方法好有效率，慳時間又慳人手。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 jau5 haau6 leot6 haan1 si4 gaan3 jau6 haan1 jan4 sau2

rows.note: Use 慳 when efficient means economical with a specified resource, especially electricity, fuel, time, or effort.

example.english: This air conditioner is very efficient and saves a lot on the electricity bill each month.
example.traditional: 呢部冷氣機幾慳電，一個月慳到好多電費。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 gei2 haan1 din6 jat1 go3 jyut6 haan1 dou2 hou2 do1 din6 fai3
